race.description: Frankston Sand Soil & Mini Mix Mdn Plate
race.comment: AUTUMN LOVER (10) is a promising fill resuming for the Moody & Coleman team. Was well supported in her debut prep without breaking through but was far from disgraced. Was pushed out in recent jumpout, that should have her ready to go. COSMIC SHOWER (2) has been in the money at both runs this time in work, doing it at both ways. The maiden win looks imminent following a good second over 1100m at this track last time. This could be his day. KUNG FU PANDA (15) dropped out quickly on debut back in March when leading them up but looks to have come on nicely during the break, stripping fitter for two sharp jumpouts. Is drawn to advantage and could give plenty of cheek. MAHRAJAN (4) showed good tactical speed when resuming here two week ago, only to be outsprinted late. Fitter now and is in the mix.
